# licensor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licensor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The party granting a licence ([odrl:assigner](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner)). A specialisation of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md). Non-functional: a licence may be granted jointly.
